BE&K Building Group, a regional and national leader providing integrated construction management and design-build services through advanced technologies, announced Jan. 1 that that Frank Holley has been appointed president and CEO.

Holley joined BE&K in 1991, assuming progressive roles of responsibility culminating in his most recent appointment. During his 28 years with the company, his responsibilities have included project management, operations oversight, business unit leadership and national sales leadership. Holley, who has more than 45 years of construction industry experience, will provide comprehensive oversight and leadership for all of the company’s operations nationwide. He will deliver hands-on experience combined with a personal knowledge of what has made the company successful to lead BE&K into the future.

“BE&K Building Group has proudly served its clients for more than 50 years,” Holley said. “I am grateful to have been part of nearly 30 of those years.
Knowing our company’s strong, successful history and track record, I’m humbled and honored to step into this new role. I am also very excited about our company’s future as we continue to onboard new, first-in-class team members to join our existing five-star talent. Together, we will chart the course for our company’s future as we continue to deliver the finest services and results for our clients.”

BE&K Building Group is a fully integrated construction company serving clients in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology, advanced manufacturing and distribution, aerospace, food and beverage, health care, higher education, and commercial sectors. A full range of services is offered including construction management, design-build, preconstruction, programming and master planning, and client advisory and consulting.

The company operates nationwide with offices in Greenville; Research Triangle Park, North Carolina; Houston; and Chicago.
Additional information is available at [https://bekbg.com/](http://bit.ly/2REgno4) .

excerpts: Richter to lead the company into its next chapter of growth and continued success._ RALEIGH, NC, UNITED STATES, August 10, 2026 / [EINPresswire.com](https://www.einpresswire.com/) / -- BE&K Building Group (BE&K), a leading design-build and construction management services company with more than 55 years of national experience delivering complex, high-performance projects, has [announced](https://bekbg.com/david-l-richter-named-chief-executive-officer-at-bek-building-group/) that David L. Richter, PE, PMP, CCQM, has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Frank Holley, who has served as the company's CEO since 2019, has transitioned to the role of Chairman as part of a planned leadership succession. Nidal Zayed, Chairman, President, and CEO of Pernix Group (BE&K's parent company), remarked that this transition honors the company's growth under Frank's leadership and sets the stage for its next chapter under David. "Under Frank's guidance, BE&K has achieved significant growth in recent years. Frank has produced a stronger organization through his visionary leadership, unwavering commitment to the company's clients, and focus on a culture centered on safety and service excellence," he said. "As a Pernix board member for nearly five years, David's deep understanding of BE&K's business, his proven leadership, and his commitment to our company's values position him well to lead the company through its next phase of growth and innovation." Reflecting on the transition, Holley shared, "Leading this company as its CEO for the past seven years has been the privilege of my career, and I am immensely proud of what we have accomplished together. Our success has always been driven, first and foremost, by the dedication of our leadership and employees and the trust of our clients and business partners. I am excited about BE&K's future under David's leadership and its next phase of growth, supported by BE&K's President and Chief Operating Officer Pat Chisholm. I look forward to working closely with David over the next several months during this leadership transition." Richter is a civil engineer, attorney, and successful business executive with more than 30 years of experience in executive leadership, strategic planning, project management, infrastructure development, corporate law and governance, and mergers and acquisitions in the engineering and construction industry. Most recently, he was Executive Vice President and Chief Growth Officer with the national engineering and construction firm Atwell, where he led strategic growth efforts which resulted in the doubling of that firm's annual revenue in just four years.
